defect: ArrowMetadataGetValue declares an unused local 'int64_t size', which breaks the build when warnings are treated as errors.
reason: The fix only removes that unused variable added by this change, and its message says the warning broke compilation.

defect: The fix adds a Prepare helper that finalizes before re-preparing, closing statement leaks in the sqlite wrapper test.
reason: The leaking re-prepare (the second prepare after the failing steps) predates this change, which itself finalized after each new prepare; the fix is a test-only change.

defect: The fix moves frame-of-reference application out of UnPackGroup into the bitpacking scan code.
reason: In this header the fix is a refactor; ApplyFrameOfReference itself is correct and the bugs the fix repairs (fast path ignoring FOR, overflow and analyze handling) live in bitpacking.cpp.

defect: Flush now returns false when subtracting the frame of reference overflows, but BitpackingFinalAnalyze and the compress Finalize ignore that result, so an overflowing last partial group passes analysis and is then not written (or trips the D_ASSERT) during compression.
reason: The fix replaces the after-the-fact TrySubtract in Flush with a per-value DifferenceFits check in Update so analysis bounces before compression, repairing the failure mode this change created.

defect: The regenerated list turns EpochMs/EpochNs/EpochUs and MakeTimestamp into DUCKDB_SCALAR_FUNCTION entries although they are implemented as GetFunctions() sets, breaking the build.
reason: The fix restores the _SET macros (and the matching header and json) for exactly these entries; seeing that they are function sets needs date_part.cpp and make_date.cpp.

defect: windows.h and delayimp.h are included with quotes in a header pulled into duckdb.hpp, which the amalgamation script tries to resolve as project files and fails on.
reason: The fix switches to angle brackets; the build break is only visible with scripts/amalgamation.py, which raises on unresolved quoted includes.

defect: The new date/time/timestamp cast benchmarks select column i, but their tables only have column d, so every benchmark query fails to bind.
reason: The fix changes the three queries to use d, repairing lines this change added.

defect: TemplatedOptimumArray compares only the child element at the row index instead of iterating over all array elements at lidx*array_size + k, so min/max over ARRAY values is wrong.
reason: The fix rewrites exactly this new function to loop over all elements with the correct child offsets and counts.

defect: The fix drops one nullptr argument from the DataFrameScanFunction TableFunction constructor call.
reason: This change only reformatted that call without changing its arguments; the fix adapts to a later TableFunction signature change.

defect: EXPORT is added to the single-child sink case, which dereferences op->children[0], but EXPORT has no child for an empty database.
reason: The fix gives EXPORT its own case that returns when there is no child; knowing the child is optional needs the EXPORT planning code.

defect: The fix simplifies the option/value map with constructors and adds options introduced later (e.g. pivot_limit).
reason: It is a test update for settings added 117 days later, not a defect in this change.

defect: The fix renames the autocomplete header to sql_auto_complete-extension.hpp and updates the include.
reason: The include matched the file that existed at this change; the fix is a naming-convention rename.

defect: A leftover Printer::Print debug call prints the USE target for every transformed USE statement.
reason: The fix removes exactly that debug print added by this change.

defect: The fix uses the delim scan's cardinality instead of the join's as the estimated cardinality of the DISTINCT aggregate (issue 16213).
reason: This change only renamed distinct_ref to distinct; the cardinality argument was already op.estimated_cardinality before it.

defect: The fix removes a blank line and rewrites the region condition to test the constant name instead of calling getenv.
reason: The change's getenv-based fallback from AWS_REGION to AWS_DEFAULT_REGION was correct; the fix is cosmetic (and its new condition is always true).

defect: EliminateCandidateFormats is declared void and prunes the shared DateFormatMap format list, so a non-date string field pops every format and the caller infers failure from an empty list, breaking date/timestamp detection for other fields.
reason: The fix makes it return bool and keeps the formats when all fail; the logic behind this declaration is in json_structure.cpp.

defect: Setting NUM_PREC_RADIX from -1 to 0 for non-numeric types in the type table changes the values SQLGetTypeInfo returns, not only the descriptor field it was meant for.
reason: The fix restores -1 in the table and maps -1 to 0 only in DescRecord::SetSqlDescType, showing the table edit was an unwanted behaviour change.

defect: The fix reverts the expected NUM_PREC_RADIX in the SQLGetTypeInfo test from 0 to -1.
reason: This test expectation tracked the product change and is reverted with it; the fix is a test change.

defect: The new D_ASSERT(InMemory()) in GetOffset fires when FixedSizeAllocator::New picks a buffer with free space that is only on disk, although Get() would load it.
reason: The fix removes that assertion from GetOffset; seeing it is wrong needs Get() in the header and the caller in fixed_size_allocator.cpp.

defect: The fix removes the PK/FK fallback for empty parsed expressions, asserts they are non-empty and moves declarations.
reason: This is a code-coverage cleanup of code that predates the change, not a repair of a defect it introduced.

defect: The fix deletes the unused hugeint_t BSwap specialization to silence an unused-code warning.
reason: It removes unused code 81 days later, after an intermediate commit had already rewritten the specialization; no wrong behaviour or build failure is repaired.

defect: The fix returns early from ApplyFiltersToFileList when there are no filters.
reason: With no filters the loop keeps all files anyway, so this is a shortcut; the bug named by the fix commit (an overwritten flag) is in parquet-extension.cpp.

defect: The fix relaxes REQUIRE_THROWS_AS(..., InternalException) to REQUIRE_THROWS.
reason: SplitWithParentheses was later changed to throw a non-internal exception and the test follows it; a test change.

defect: The new assertions require the input and result auxiliary/buffer pointers to differ, which fails when both are null.
reason: The fix allows equality when the pointer is nullptr, repairing the assertions this change added.

defect: The fix replaces 'lambda_values[entry] > 0' with a plain truth test on the bool.
reason: The comparison is equivalent and the '> 0' was already present before the change; the fix is a drive-by style edit.

defect: The fix removes a third where_clause argument passed to a format string with only two %s.
reason: The extra argument was already passed before this change, which only rewrote the literal as a raw string.

defect: For two-part names CreateStructPack now only tries BindingAlias(schema, table), dropping the old acceptance of catalog.table, so struct packs like database.table no longer bind.
reason: The fix retries a two-part name as catalog with INVALID_SCHEMA; the meaning of the two-argument BindingAlias is defined elsewhere.

defect: ScanCount leaves the scanned list offsets absolute in the child column while the child vector is filled from 0, and advances the state with NextVector, so lists after the first vector point at the wrong children.
reason: The fix rebases the offsets to the first entry and advances the scan states by count, repairing code added in this new file.

defect: The fix renames is_numeric to numeric_width as part of width-limited numeric parsing in strptime.
reason: The fix is a feature for issue 1158; the clear() lines this change added are only renamed.

defect: The fix corrects the %g comment range and replaces is_numeric with numeric_width.
reason: The comment fix is documentation and the numeric_width redesign addresses pre-existing unbounded number parsing.

defect: The fix only rewraps an over-long constructor call.
reason: Formatting change with no behaviour difference.

defect: The fix reverts the manually unrolled offset loop to a plain loop.
reason: The unrolled loop computes the same locations correctly; removing it is a cleanup, not a defect repair.

defect: The fix replaces chunk.data[col_idx].type with GetType().
reason: It adapts to a Vector API change made 110 days later, not a defect in this change.

defect: CastFromDate::Operation returns a new[]-allocated char buffer that its callers store and never free, leaking memory on every date-to-string cast.
reason: The fix makes it return std::string; that no caller frees the buffer is visible only in value.cpp and vector_helpers.cpp.

defect: The fix routes DATE-to-VARCHAR casts through the string-heap path instead of storing CastFromDate's raw new[] pointer.
reason: The leaking direct DATE cast loop existed before this change, which only added the IGNORE_NULL flag.

defect: The fix changes the CastFromDate declaration to return std::string to remove a leak.
reason: This change only made the return type const char*; the leaking allocation was introduced earlier.

defect: For a non-integer constant ORDER BY term the new OrderBinder returns the constant itself, but the caller asserts a BOUND_COLUMN_REF and later binding expects one.
reason: The fix returns nullptr so the caller drops the term; the assertion is in bind_select_node.cpp.

defect: The fix makes FinalizeExternal skip empty partitions when choosing the partitions for the next round.
reason: The 'at least one partition starting at partitions_start' selection predates this change, which only renamed tuples_per_iteration.

defect: The new early return when the remaining partitions hold zero tuples leaves the HT unfinalized, so PreparePartitionedRound treats the join as done and skips probing those partitions (losing outer/anti join rows).
reason: The fix removes that early return and signals remaining rounds with a bool; the effect depends on the caller in physical_hash_join.cpp.

defect: FinalizeExternal became a void PrepareExternalFinalize that no longer finalizes, yet GetData still detects the end of rounds via 'finalized', so external joins stop after the first round and never build the pointer table there.
reason: The fix makes PrepareExternalFinalize return bool and finalizes in PreparePartitionedRound; the broken caller is in physical_hash_join.cpp.
